title: Re-derive ownership compliance in the handoff validator
objective: validate_handoff refuses a handoff whose changed_files contain a path outside the task's allowed_paths, regardless of the ownership_compliance flag the handoff reports about itself.
scope: The handoff ownership gate inside tools/agent/validation.py and its unit tests.
acceptance_criteria: A handoff changing a file outside allowed_paths raises agent.ownership_violation
A handoff that stays inside allowed_paths validates cleanly
handoff_requirements: Report the focused pytest run for tests/unit/agent_tools
Report ruff and mypy for tools/agent
Report the GitHub Quality Gate result for the PR
